newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat says not interested in Russian AvtoVAZ.
newsitem.headline: Fiat says not interested in Russian AvtoVAZ.

text.p: Italy's Fiat group has no interest whatsoever in taking over Russia's indebted carmaker AvtoVAZ, Fiat Managing Director Paolo Cantarella said.
A senior Russian minister on Tuesday called for bankruptcy authorities to start proceedings against AvtoVAZ, which the government says is one of the country's biggest tax debtors.
Talking to reporters while attending a meeting of Fiat managers in Turin, Cantarella said: "We have already said that we are not interested."
AvtoVAZ's main Lada car is based on a 1960s or 1970s Fiat model and Russian sources had speculated that the Turin-based giant might be interested in taking over the ailing company.
